# Free Maps

Free Maps is an MIT-licensed, renderer-neutral map element toolkit. The demo uses MapLibre GL JS, Protomaps styling, OpenStreetMap data, protected PMTiles and synthetic GeoJSON markers.

Canonical routes:
- [Explorer](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/)
- [Compact embeds](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/embed/)
- [Element states](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/states/)
- [Vanilla integration](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/vanilla/)
- [React integration](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/react/)
- [5,000-point stress test](https://free-maps.forkandflag.com/stress/)

No Google Maps components or requests are involved.
